import Base

# A finite list denotes a stream with an absorbing zero tail.
def uncons0(-R: Type, cells: List<&2, U32>, consume: U32 -> List<&2, U32> -> R) -> R:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      consume(0, Nil{})
    case Con{head, tail}:
      consume(head, tail)

# Horizontal windows restart at each row boundary.
def horizontal(cells: List<&2, U32>, +width: U32, +column: U32, left: U32) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+here, +rest}:
      +next = U32.inc(column)
      +seam = U32.is_eq(next, width)
      right = uncons0(U32, rest, value => unused => value)
      total = (left + here + Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, right) : U32)
      total <> horizontal(rest, width,
        Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, next),
        Bool.pick(U32, seam, 0, here))

# OR with the live bit merges neighbor counts 2 and 3 only for survivors.
def life(+here: U32, total: U32) -> U32:
  neighbors = (total - here : U32)
  Bool.to_u32(U32.is_eq(U32.or(neighbors, here), 3))

# Consume three zero-extended streams in lockstep with the output shape.
def vertical(cells: List<&2, U32>, above: List<&2, U32>, middle: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{here, rest}:
      uncons0(List<&2, U32>, above, north => norths =>
        uncons0(List<&2, U32>, middle, center => centers =>
          uncons0(List<&2, U32>, below, south => souths =>
            life(here, (north + center + south : U32)) <>
              vertical(rest, norths, centers, souths))))

# Exact input length carries height; cells supplies the output shape.
def step(+width: U32, height: U32, +cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +span = U32.to_nat(width)
  +band = horizontal(cells, width, 0, 0)
  above = List.append(&2, U32, List.replicate(U32, span, 0), band)
  below = List.drop(&2, U32, band, span)
  vertical(cells, above, band, below)

def evolve(turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+remaining:
      evolve(remaining, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
hypothesis: Retain the stimulus-inspired separable stencil and zero-extended streams. The concrete improvement collapses birth and survival into one equality: (neighbors OR here) = 3. For a dead cell this accepts exactly three neighbors; for a live cell it accepts exactly two or three. Subtracting the center from the closed neighborhood sum supplies neighbors without underflow. This replaces three comparisons and two Boolean combinators with subtraction, bitwise OR and one comparison, exposing the one-bit difference between birth and survival.
findings: The repaired prior implementation passed the supplied Node, Bun and native observations, including composition checks; semantic review reported no issues. The earlier computed-scrutinee diagnostic was confirmed and repaired through continuation-based elimination, which is retained. Style shortfalls remain unresolved, particularly the stricter big-brain target on every declaration. This revision concretely simplifies the transition algebra while preserving the evaluated traversal and boundary handling. Compiler acceptance, runtime behavior and style ratings for this revision await independent evaluation.
